name: Yarnbit · Gremlet #30
description:
A ball of yarn that rolled under the sofa and came back alive. Trails a loose thread everywhere.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Yarnbit in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
